title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode6 A Stage in a Flower Field

meta.Episode: Episode6 — A Stage in a Flower Field
meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_ppr_op3
Stage SEKAI
Flower Field

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This appears to be where the street version of me was transported.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I really wasn't expecting her to be sent to another SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Do the trees in SEKAI have something to do with all this...?)
Huh?! Wh-Wh-Wh-Where am I?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
...!
There she is over there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'd be startled too if I woke up and realized that I was in a completely different SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This place isn't a part of our SEKAI, is it...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I've done a lot of exploring. I'm sure that I would've noticed these big stages if we had any.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
On the other hand...
This could be my lucky day!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Len and the others would be so surprised by this flower field and these stages.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, KAITO and Miku are going to be so jealous when I tell them that I got to do a show here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, since I'm here, let's do some singing!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The me from that SEKAI never changes...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ever the free spirit, and always thinking positive.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
It feels so good to sing somewhere so beautiful!
Is someone there?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, what's going on?!
Why are there two of us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's another me...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Under normal circumstances, I'd never see another me in this SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But when those fragments of feelings sent me to that other SEKAI, I met a different version of myself.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (What if some strange power is at work like that time?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?!
Is this not my SEKAI at all or something?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
For now, please try to calm down.
There's no need to worry.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't know what caused you to be sent here, but I'm sure you'll find a way back to your own SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, in the meantime, why don't you make yourself at home?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Welcome to our SEKAI.
And it's wonderful to meet you♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Y-You're so cute!
What was that? You looked like an idol!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I mean, I am an idol.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, the others and I work very hard to give everyone hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Really...?!
I could even be an idol, huh!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Doesn't this mean that my potential's limitless?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure you can do anything if you put your mind to it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Exactly!
I'm starting to feel so proud of myself♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Those two are already acting like old friends.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose it makes sense that two of “me” would get along so well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know! We should celebrate our meeting by singing together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This stage is so big, it must be tons of fun to sing together with someone here!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, together?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, alright.
Let's sing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This is wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (A powerful singing voice and a flowery singing voice... Their feelings meet, mix, and draw out each other's best points.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I could listen to them forever.
This way! I can hear someone singing over there!
Are Miku and the others doing a show?
I don't know... Maybe!
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? That looks like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, hi!
You must all be from this SEKAI♪

rows.Speaker: Rin, KAITO & MEIKO
rows.Line: Whaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, so...
You're Luka from another SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's right.
But the way you're treating me feels a bit strange.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just talk to me the way you normally do with Luka. Although, I'm not as cute as her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's not true.
I think you're very cute♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
I wish my Miku could hear you say that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Speaking of Miku, where is she?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She isn't here either.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, she's gone?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. She promised to work on some new dance routines with me today, but I haven't been able to find her anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Considering that a me from another SEKAI is here, it's possible our Miku was sent to another SEKAI herself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She was sent to a different SEKAI...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I-Is she gonna be okay?!
Won't she be really lonely...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm also worried...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She'll be fine!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't know what your Miku is like, but I bet she knows how to stay positive, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So even if she is in a different SEKAI, I bet she's having a grand adventure!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sure, I was a little uneasy when I first got here, but I bet any SEKAI would welcome her with open arms!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So basically, uh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's nothing to worry about!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I think Luka's right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'll just have to get Miku to tell us all about where she went after she gets back.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That felt like...
The creators of this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I believe so.
Let us introduce you to them, Luka.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait! Slow down!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Since I'm here, I want to give them the best greeting I can!
